lessons.title: वो (vo) — he, the man you talk about
lessons.gloss: he: the man you talk about

segments.source: [PAUSE 2s]

segments.text: Say how you are: हूं ठीक हूं। (hū̃ ṭhīk hū̃.) Then ask the polite question: आप कैसो हो? (āp kaiso ho?)
So far you talk about yourself, हूं, and to the person in front of you, आप. Now a third person: someone you talk about.
वो राम है। vo rām hai. — He is Ram.
वो (vo) is he: a man you are talking about, not to. He comes first, and है ends the sentence, as it does in म्हारो नाम राम है।.
वो बीमार है। vo bīmār hai. — He is ill.
Old Marwari already had vo, "that": CDIAL lists it under Sanskrit asau, "that" (CDIAL 972). This book keeps वो for a man, and names a woman by a word you know: मां, बहन, छोरी.

segments.source: [PAUSE 1s]

segments.instruction: वो छोरो है। — vo chhoro hai. — He is a boy.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **वो छोरो है।** — *vo chhoro hai.* — He is a boy.]

segments.instruction: वो बीमार है पण हूं ठीक हूं। — vo bīmār hai paṇ hū̃ ṭhīk hū̃. — He is ill, but I am fine.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **वो बीमार है पण हूं ठीक हूं।** — *vo bīmār hai paṇ hū̃ ṭhīk hū̃.* — He is ill, but I am fine.]

segments.instruction: हूं राजी हूं क्यूंकै वो अठै है। — hū̃ rājī hū̃ kyū̃kai vo aṭhai hai. — I am happy because he is here.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **हूं राजी हूं क्यूंकै वो अठै है।** — *hū̃ rājī hū̃ kyū̃kai vo aṭhai hai.* — I am happy because he is here.]
[PAUSE 3s]

segments.text: Who is वो (vo)? (A man you are talking about.) Which word ends वो (vo) बीमार है।? (है.)

segments.prompt: Say that he is ill, but you are fine.
acceptedResponses: वो बीमार है पण हूं ठीक हूं।
vo bīmār hai paṇ hū̃ ṭhīk hū̃
vo bimar hai pan hu thik hu

feedback.correct: Right: वो for him, हूं for you, and पण between.
feedback.incorrect: Start with वो बीमार है, then पण, then हूं ठीक हूं.

lessons.title: यो and वो (vo) — this one here, that one there
lessons.gloss: this and that: the near one and the far one

segments.source: [PAUSE 2s]

segments.text: Say he is a boy. Then the near word you know, यो (yo), "this". And offer the old choice once more: चाय अर पाणी? (chāy ar pāṇī?)
वो (vo) also points at a thing away from you: that. यो is the near one, this.
यो म्हारो घर है। yo mhāro ghar hai. — This is my house.
वो दुकान है। vo dukān hai. — That is a shop.
So वो (vo) is he or that: a man, or a thing over there.
Offer two things the way you offered tea or water: यो अर वो? (yo ar vo?), this or that?

segments.source: [PAUSE 1s]

segments.instruction: यो पाणी है। — yo pāṇī hai. — This is water.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **यो पाणी है।** — *yo pāṇī hai.* — This is water.]

segments.instruction: वो चाय है। — vo chāy hai. — That is tea.
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **वो चाय है।** — *vo chāy hai.* — That is tea.]

segments.instruction: यो अर वो? — yo ar vo? — This or that?
segments.source: [YOU SAY: **यो अर वो?** — *yo ar vo?* — This or that?]
[YOU SAY: **वो।** — *vo.* — That one.]
[PAUSE 3s]

segments.text: Which is near, यो or वो (vo)? (यो.) What else can वो (vo) be? (He.)

segments.prompt: Offer someone a choice: this or that?

feedback.correct: Right: यो is near, वो is over there, and अर offers both.
feedback.incorrect: Say यो, then अर, then वो, with a question in your voice.

segments.text: He is here? (वो (vo) अठै है।) That is a shop? (वो (vo) दुकान है।) Tea or water? (चाय अर पाणी?) He is ill, but I am fine? (वो (vo) बीमार है पण हूं ठीक हूं।).

segments.prompt: Say: that is a shop, but this is my house.
acceptedResponses: वो दुकान है पण यो म्हारो घर है।
vo dukān hai paṇ yo mhāro ghar hai
vo dukan hai pan yo mharo ghar hai

feedback.correct: Right: वो over there, यो right here, and पण between.
feedback.incorrect: Say वो दुकान है, then पण, then यो म्हारो घर है.
